title: Append a text message to a file
summary: Add a line of text to the end of an existing file without overwriting its current content. This is useful for adding notes or configuration lines to text files.

aliases.text: add line to end of file
как добавить текст в файл не удаляя старый

steps.explain: Use the echo command with the double greater-than operator (>>) to append the text to the specified file. If the file does not exist, it will be created.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: The path to the file you want to modify
